author: The Infographics Show
description:
What happens if the world suddenly stops trusting the U.S. dollar?

In this day-by-day scenario, foreign investors stop buying U.S. debt, Treasury yields spike, banks begin to fail, and borrowing costs explode across the country. Mortgages get more expensive, imports cost more, the dollar weakens, businesses struggle to pay overseas suppliers, and shortages begin spreading into everyday life. Eventually, the Federal Reserve is forced to step in and create trillions of new dollars just to stabilize the system.
But the dollar doesn’t disappear. Instead, America loses something almost as valuable. The privilege of borrowing more cheaply than everyone else.

The dollar may survive, but the cost of keeping it alive could hit almost every American.

title: What if the World Dumps US Dollar (Day by Day)

description:
Britain is telling households to stockpile enough supplies to survive at least 72 hours without outside help.

The government’s new “Be Ready” campaign recommends keeping water, long-lasting food, batteries, flashlights, radios, medicine, and other essentials at home. It isn’t warning about one specific disaster. Severe storms, flooding, power failures, water shortages, and cyberattacks could all disrupt the systems modern life depends on. And when the power goes out, the problem goes far beyond the lights. Wi-Fi disappears, card payments stop, fuel pumps fail, phones die, water systems can go down.

The message is simple. Don’t panic buy. But make sure your family can survive the first three days on its own.
